title: Aidlc: Adaptive workflow steering rules for AI coding agents
summary: Aidlc is an AWS Labs project that provides adaptive workflow steering rules for AI coding agents, enabling developers to define and control the behavior flow of AI-powered coding assistants through configurable rule sets.
problem_solved: It solves the problem of unpredictable or uncontrollable AI coding agent behavior by providing structured workflow steering rules.
why_valuable: As AI coding assistants proliferate, having a framework to guide and constrain their behavior ensures more reliable, consistent, and safe development workflows.
